This document describes the internal architecture of MPAQT for developers and maintainers. Understanding this structure will help you contribute to the package or extend its functionality.

## High-Level Architecture

```
MPAQT Package Architecture
==========================

    User Interface Layer
    ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │                                                             │
    │   R API                          CLI (inst/bin/mpaqt)       │
    │   - mpaqt_index()                - mpaqt index              │
    │   - mpaqt_prepare_short_reads()  - mpaqt prepare-sr         │
    │   - mpaqt_prepare_long_reads()   - mpaqt prepare-lr         │
    │   - mpaqt_quant()                - mpaqt quant              │
    │                                                             │
    └───────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────┘
                                │
    Processing Layer            │
    ┌───────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────┐
    │                                                             │
    │   Short-Read Processing      Long-Read Processing           │
    │   (process-short-read.R)     (process-long-read.R)          │
    │                                                             │
    │   Pre-Quantification         Post-Quantification            │
    │   (quant-pre.R)              (quant-post.R)                 │
    │                                                             │
    └───────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────┘
                                │
    Algorithm Layer             │
    ┌───────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────┐
    │                                                             │
    │   EM Algorithm    Newton-Raphson    Prior Models    Bias    │
    │   (algo-em.R)     (algo-newton.R)   (algo-prior.R)  Corr.   │
    │                                                     (algo-  │
    │                                                     bias.R) │
    └───────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────┘
                                │
    Infrastructure Layer        │
    ┌───────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────┐
    │                                                             │
    │   System Commands    Kallisto/Bustools    Minimap2/Bambu    │
    │   (infra-system.R)   (infra-kallisto.R)   (infra-minimap2.R │
    │                                            infra-bambu.R)   │
    └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## R/ Directory Organization

The `R/` directory contains 21 files organized by function:

### API Layer (User-Facing Functions)

| File | Functions | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `api-index.R` | `mpaqt_index()`, `mpaqt_read_index()` | Index creation and I/O |
| `api-quant.R` | `mpaqt_quant()`, `mpaqt_quant_bulk()`, `mpaqt_quant_sc()` | Main quantification entry points |

These files contain the primary user-facing functions. They orchestrate the workflow by calling processing, algorithm, and infrastructure functions.

### Class Definitions

| File | Classes | Description |
|------|---------|-------------|
| `class-index.R` | `mpaqt_index` | Reference index with transcripts, genes, EC mappings |
| `class-counts.R` | `mpaqt_counts_sr`, `mpaqt_counts_lr` | Short-read and long-read count containers |
| `class-result.R` | `mpaqt_quant_result` | Quantification results with TPM, abundances, uncertainty |

All classes are S3 classes with constructor functions (`new_*`), print methods, summary methods, and subsetting operators.

### Processing Layer

| File | Functions | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `process-short-read.R` | `mpaqt_prepare_short_reads()`, `mpaqt_prepare_short_reads_sc()` | FASTQ to EC counts |
| `process-long-read.R` | `mpaqt_prepare_long_reads()`, `mpaqt_prepare_long_reads_sc()` | FASTQ/counts to transcript counts |
| `quant-pre.R` | `mpaqt_prequant()` | Pre-quantification (bias estimation) |
| `quant-post.R` | `mpaqt_postquant()` | Post-quantification (EM algorithm) |

### Algorithm Layer (Internal)

| File | Functions | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `algo-em.R` | `run_em_algorithm()` | Core EM loop with convergence checking |
| `algo-newton.R` | `compute_newton_update()` | Newton-Raphson optimization step |
| `algo-prior.R` | `fit_prior_model_gpboost()`, `fit_prior_model_lme4()` | Mixed-effects prior models |
| `algo-bias.R` | `init_positional_bias()`, `optimize_positional_weights()` | 3'/5' positional bias correction |

These files are marked as `@keywords internal` and are not exported.

### Infrastructure Layer (Internal)

| File | Functions | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `infra-system.R` | `run_system_command()` | Wrapper for system2() with logging |
| `infra-kallisto.R` | `run_kallisto_index()`, `run_kallisto_bus()` | Kallisto/bustools wrappers |
| `infra-minimap2.R` | `run_minimap2_lr()`, `check_minimap2()` | Minimap2 wrappers |
| `infra-bambu.R` | `run_bambu()`, `check_bambu()` | Bambu quantification wrappers |

### Utility Files

| File | Functions | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `validate.R` | `validate_*()`, `check_*()` | Input validation and tool checking |
| `extract-transcriptome.R` | `extract_transcriptome_from_gtf()` | Transcriptome extraction from genome |

### Package Infrastructure

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `mpaqt-package.R` | Package-level documentation and imports |
| `zzz.R` | `.onLoad()` and `.onAttach()` hooks |

## Data Flow

### Bulk Workflow Data Flow

```
                     GTF + FASTA/Genome
                            │
                            ▼
                    ┌───────────────┐
                    │ mpaqt_index() │
                    └───────┬───────┘
                            │
                            ▼
                      mpaqt_index
                       (S3 object)
                            │
          ┌─────────────────┼─────────────────┐
          │                 │                 │
          ▼                 │                 ▼
┌─────────────────┐         │      ┌─────────────────┐
│ mpaqt_prepare_  │         │      │ mpaqt_prepare_  │
│ short_reads()   │         │      │ long_reads()    │
└────────┬────────┘         │      └────────┬────────┘
         │                  │               │
         ▼                  │               ▼
  mpaqt_counts_sr           │        mpaqt_counts_lr
         │                  │               │
         └──────────────────┼───────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
                    ┌───────────────┐
                    │ mpaqt_quant() │
                    └───────┬───────┘
                            │
              ┌─────────────┴─────────────┐
              │                           │
              ▼                           ▼
       mpaqt_prequant()           mpaqt_postquant()
       (bias estimation)          (EM algorithm)
              │                           │
              └─────────────┬─────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
                   mpaqt_quant_result
                            │
               ┌────────────┼────────────┐
               │            │            │
               ▼            ▼            ▼
            tpm()    abundances()   uncertainty()
```

## S3 Class Hierarchy

### mpaqt_index

```r
mpaqt_index
├── transcripts      # Character vector of transcript IDs
├── genes            # Character vector of gene IDs
├── gene_map         # Named vector: transcript -> gene
├── ec_ids           # Equivalence class IDs
├── p_matrices       # List of P matrices for each EC
├── distances        # Transcript length information
├── covariates       # Optional covariate data
├── kallisto_index   # Path to kallisto index binary
├── metadata         # List with creation info
└── class: "mpaqt_index"
```

### mpaqt_counts_sr

```r
mpaqt_counts_sr
├── counts           # Sparse matrix: EC x samples
├── ec_ids           # Matching EC IDs
├── transcripts      # Transcript IDs from index
├── metadata         # Processing information
└── class: c("mpaqt_counts_sr", "mpaqt_counts")
```

### mpaqt_counts_lr

```r
mpaqt_counts_lr
├── counts           # Matrix: transcript x samples
├── transcripts      # Transcript IDs
├── metadata         # Processing information
└── class: c("mpaqt_counts_lr", "mpaqt_counts")
```

### mpaqt_quant_result

```r
mpaqt_quant_result
├── abundances       # Numeric vector of abundances
├── tpm              # TPM-normalized values
├── transcripts      # Transcript IDs
├── genes            # Gene IDs
├── log_likelihood   # Final log-likelihood
├── convergence      # Convergence info (iterations, tolerance)
├── positional_weights # Bias correction weights (if used)
├── uncertainty      # Standard errors (if computed)
├── metadata         # Parameters and input info
└── class: "mpaqt_quant_result"
```

## Dependency Management Pattern

MPAQT uses a tiered dependency approach:

### Required Dependencies (Imports)

Always available, loaded with the package:

```r
import(data.table)
import(Matrix)
import(cli)
```

### Optional Dependencies (Suggests)

Loaded on-demand using `require_bioc()`:

```r
# In R/validate.R
require_bioc <- function(pkg, reason = "for this operation") {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    cli::cli_abort(c(
      "Package {.pkg {pkg}} is required {reason}.",
      "i" = "Install it with: {.code BiocManager::install(\"{pkg}\")}"
    ))
  }
}

# Usage in other files
require_bioc("Biostrings", "to extract transcriptome sequences")
```

### External Tool Checking

Tools are checked only when needed:

```r
# In R/validate.R
check_tool_exists <- function(tool, min_version = NULL) {
  path <- Sys.which(tool)
  if (path == "") {
    cli::cli_abort(c(
      "{.strong {tool}} is not installed or not in PATH.",
      "i" = "Install with: {.code conda install -c bioconda {tool}}"
    ))
  }
  invisible(path)
}
```

---

## Pathway Detection Pattern

MPAQT supports multiple input pathways. Detection is centralized in `validate.R`:

```r
detect_sr_pathway <- function(fastq_1, fastq_2, bus_file, ec_file, rds_file) {
  if (!is.null(rds_file)) return("rds")
  if (!is.null(bus_file) && !is.null(ec_file)) return("bus")
  if (!is.null(fastq_1) && !is.null(fastq_2)) return("fastq")
  cli::cli_abort("Could not determine input pathway")
}
```

Each processing function then dispatches based on the pathway:

```r
mpaqt_prepare_short_reads <- function(...) {
  pathway <- detect_sr_pathway(...)

  switch(pathway,
    "fastq" = sr_pathway_fastq(...),
    "bus"   = sr_pathway_bus(...),
    "rds"   = sr_pathway_rds(...)
  )
}
```

---

## Error Handling Pattern

MPAQT uses `cli` for informative error messages:

```r
# Good error message pattern
cli::cli_abort(c(
  "Failed to create index.",
  "x" = "GTF file not found: {.file {annotation}}",
  "i" = "Ensure the file exists and is readable."
))

# Validation pattern
validate_file_exists <- function(path, arg_name = "file") {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    cli::cli_abort(c(
      "{.arg {arg_name}} does not exist.",
      "x" = "File not found: {.file {path}}"
    ))
  }
  invisible(path)
}
```

---

## Adding New Features

### Adding a New Processing Pathway

1. Add detection logic in `validate.R`:
   ```r
   detect_new_pathway <- function(...) { ... }
   ```

2. Create pathway-specific function:
   ```r
   new_pathway_handler <- function(...) { ... }
   ```

3. Add switch case in main function

4. Document new parameters with roxygen2

### Adding a New S3 Method

1. Create generic in appropriate class file:
   ```r
   #' @export
   my_generic <- function(x, ...) UseMethod("my_generic")
   ```

2. Create method:
   ```r
   #' @export
   my_generic.mpaqt_quant_result <- function(x, ...) { ... }
   ```

3. Add to NAMESPACE via roxygen2 `@export` tag

---

## Testing Strategy

Tests are organized in `tests/testthat/`:

```
tests/
├── testthat.R
└── testthat/
    ├── test-index.R       # Index creation tests
    ├── test-counts.R      # Count object tests
    ├── test-quant.R       # Quantification tests
    └── fixtures/          # Test data
```

Run tests with:

```r
devtools::test()
```

---

## Documentation Standards

### Function Documentation

All exported functions should have:

```r
#' Function Title
#'
#' @description
#' Brief description of what the function does.
#'
#' @param x Description of parameter x
#' @param ... Additional arguments
#'
#' @return Description of return value
#'
#' @export
#'
#' @examples
#' \dontrun{
#' result <- my_function(x)
#' }
my_function <- function(x, ...) {
  # Implementation
}
```

### Internal Functions

Internal functions use `@keywords internal`:

```r
#' Internal Helper Function
#'
#' @keywords internal
#' @noRd
internal_helper <- function(...) {
  # Implementation
}
```

---

## Contributing Guidelines

### Code Style

- Use `snake_case` for functions and variables
- Use `mpaqt_` prefix for exported functions
- Maximum line length: 80 characters
- Use `cli::cli_abort()` for errors
- Use `cli::cli_warn()` for warnings

### Pull Request Process

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a feature branch
3. Make changes with tests
4. Run `devtools::check()`
5. Submit pull request

### Reporting Issues

Report issues at: https://github.com/csglab/MPAQT_merged/issues

Include:
- MPAQT version: `packageVersion("mpaqt")`
- R version: `R.version.string`
- Operating system
- Minimal reproducible example
